frame_convention: Frames and damage from T3 Ogre bank rows (60fps), via game/assets/movesets/t3-ogre.json. Damage scaled to WH 100HP. Inputs translated from T3 LP/RP/LK/RK commands to Tekken 1/2/3/4 notation. The extracted T3 bank is the shared Ogre/True Ogre animation bank — True Ogre's boss kit draws its animations from these rows; Chatur's canon specials (FOURFOLD MUDRA, OVERSOUL SURGE, GYOU'S MARK, REFUSED TO DIE, BRIDGE OF ARMS) replace the boss-only unblockable extensions with her four-armed temple-dancer kit.
canon_note: Chatur is True Ogre's Western Heart replacement (name locked 2026-10-22). Four-armed Oversoul spirit, temple dancer who refused to die; anchors the spirit realm; GYOU-touched. Moveset = True Ogre's Tekken 3 kit translated to her four-armed spirit body: the double palms become fourfold strikes, the unblockables become refusals. Ogre stays in the repo as Tekken reference only (t3-ogre.json). Voice: sparse, imagistic, Japanese-influenced. 'Stopping is dying. I already did that once.'

1.name: First Mudra
1.note: Quick lead palm. The first hand speaks.

2.name: Second Mudra
2.note: Right palm, heavier. The second hand answers.

1,2.name: Mudra Pair
1,2.note: First into Second. The dance opens.

f+1.name: Temple Bell Palm
f+1.note: Lunging palm strike. The bell rings once.

d/b+1+2.name: THE LONG REFUSAL
d/b+1+2.note: True Ogre's charged unblockable. Chatur holds the charge the way she held her last breath — and does not let go.

1+3.name: First Binding
1+3.note: Left-side throw. The arms close like a gate.

2+4.name: Second Binding
2+4.note: Right-side throw. Four hands, no escape.

b+2+3.name: OGRE'S ANSWER
b+2+3.note: True Ogre's heaviest single hit. Chatur lands it with all four arms behind it.

d/f,d/f+2+4.name: ANCIENT POWER
d/f,d/f+2+4.note: True Ogre's Ancient Power. Chatur's version: the double palm becomes a fourfold palm — all four arms fire at once.

FC d/b+1/2/3.name: Buried Refusal
FC d/b+1/2/3.note: From crouch, a rising unblockable. What was buried does not stay buried.

f+1+3.name: Third Binding
f+1+3.note: Forward left throw. The third hand joins the gate.

f+2+4.name: Fourth Binding
f+2+4.note: Forward right throw. All four hands close.

d/b+1+3.name: Buried Grip
d/b+1+3.note: Crouching grab. Dragged down into the mud.

d/b+2+4.name: Mud Snare
d/b+2+4.note: Snap grab from low. Quick as a temple drum.

b+2+4.name: Spirit Snatch
b+2+4.note: Back-step snatch. The spirit takes, the body follows.

d+1+2.name: THE BELL TOLLS
d+1+2.note: Chatur's heaviest charge. When the bell tolls, the gate falls.

1+4.name: Four-Arm Crush
1+4.note: Unblockable crush. Four arms, one verdict.

2+3.name: Oversoul Quake
2+3.note: The ground answers the dance. Unblockable stomp-wave.

f+3.name: Procession Kick
f+3.note: Long advancing kick. The procession moves forward.

b+4.name: Gatekeeper Heel
b+4.note: The gatekeeper does not move. The heel does.

f,f+3.name: Pilgrim's Charge
f,f+3.note: Dash kick. The pilgrim arrives running.

f,f+4.name: Thunder Heel
f,f+4.note: Dash heel. Thunder before the bell.

b+1.name: Turning Palm
b+1.note: Back-step palm, turns into the hit.

f,f+1.name: Charging Bell
f,f+1.note: Dash palm. The bell rings on arrival.

d/f+2+3.name: Stone and Root
d/f+2+3.note: Crouching twin strike, low and heavy.

d+1+4.name: Low Bell and Heel
d+1+4.note: Low palm into heel, one breath.

d/f+1+3.name: Low Binding Jab
d/f+1+3.note: Crouching jab that grabs the eye.

d/b+1+2+3.name: Enter Temple Dance
d/b+1+2+3.note: Chatur sinks into the temple dance.

u+1+4.name: Sky Mandala
u+1+4.note: Rises into the sky mandala stance.

d+2+3+4.name: Dance of Four Arms
d+2+3+4.note: The full dance. All four arms move as one.

u/b+3+4.name: Retreating Veil
u/b+3+4.note: Veil drawn back. The dance retreats.

2,2.name: Second Mudra Echo
2,2.note: Second Mudra into the echo palm.

1,1.name: First Mudra Echo
1,1.note: First Mudra into the echo palm.

1,2,1.name: Mudra Triad
1,2,1.note: The full mudra: first, second, third.

strings.note: Rising palm into First Mudra (T3 rows 24,38).
Leaping Mudra into Second Mudra (T3 rows 26,51).
Twin Gate into Procession Punch (T3 rows 109,101).
Mudra Pair into Double Refusal — the four arms arrive in order.

specials.name: FOURFOLD MUDRA
specials.note: Canon: all four arms strike at once — the ki-charge input repurposed as an attack. Chatur's signature.

specials.name: OVERSOUL SURGE
specials.note: Canon: the Oversoul spirit fires through her palms — a spirit blast. Long range, heavy.

specials.name: GYOU'S MARK
specials.note: Canon: GYOU-touched — once the dash starts she cannot be stopped; armored through the hit. 'Stopping is dying.'

specials.name: REFUSED TO DIE
specials.note: Canon: at low health, a brief armored temple-dance — she rises through the hit. Comeback tool, long cooldown.

specials.name: BRIDGE OF ARMS
specials.note: Canon: the four arms weave a bridge — auto-parries mid attacks for one beat, then ripostes.

stances.name: TEMPLE DANCE
stances.note: Her idle: the four arms rest in mudra positions, swaying. From here her canon specials chain faster.

stances.name: BRIDGE
stances.note: Parry stance: the arms weave the bridge between the living trial and the spirit realm.
